display_information.name: Your Helpful MarkBot
display_information.description: Alert hub — scheduled and workflow-driven Slack notifications
display_information.long_description: A single-identity bot for WPM Slack workspaces. It posts scheduled, data-driven alerts and workflow notifications — transcription updates, publishing lifecycle events, and AirTable-backed program reminders — as one consistent sender so nothing gets lost in the noise. Outbound only: alert recipes are fired by a cloud scheduler, with no dependence on a local machine.
